messages:
anya: Heads up — planning to enable orbital-7b-alpha in the model catalog during the 03:00 UTC change window tonight (03:00-05:00 UTC). Requesting eng + ops ack.
kevin: Quick Q — what's the fallback ordering and canary %? Any pinlist to protect enterprise tenants?
maria: Also need telemetry/rollback thresholds spelled out.
anya: Proposed:
- fallback order: orbital-quantv2 -> orbital-7b-alpha -> orbital-7b-legacy
- canary traffic: 5% for first 20 minutes, then 25% ramp if no guards fire
- force-pin: acme-corp (enterprise tenant)
kevin: Sounds fine. Add a cost spike advisory (token/unit cost >25%).
sam: Deploybot — can you schedule the enable and emit job id?
deploy-bot: Scheduled job: `deploybot enable-model --model orbital-7b-alpha --catalog main --canary 5 --start 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z` -> job_id=9876543210. Warmup scheduled at 02:30 UTC.
maria: Ops plan: we'll warm up GPUs at 02:30, start telemetry checks at 02:45, watch p50/p95, error-rate, and perf traces. Drain plan ready if rollback needed (04:30-04:45).
ops-runner: Oncall acked. We'll post live runbook updates in #eng-oncall.
anya: Rollback triggers (automated):
- http_error_rate >= 2.0% sustained for 5m
- p50 latency >= 400ms for 10m
- token cost per-request spike >= 25% for 10m (advisory + ops review)
If any trigger hits, auto-fallback to orbital-quantv2 for new requests and notify channel.
kevin: Add: fallback TTL should be 600s to avoid cache thrash.
julian: Agree with TTL. Also confirm fallback preserves KV cache affinity (we don't want cold starts).
anya: Config snippet added to the catalog config for the run:
```
catalog:
  model: orbital-7b-alpha
  fallback_order: [orbital-quantv2, orbital-7b-alpha, orbital-7b-legacy]
  fallback_ttl_s: 600
  canary_traffic_pct: 5
  rollback_triggers:
    http_error_rate: 0.02
    p50_latency_ms: 400
```
sam: I'll draft the release notes and include the force-pin note for acme-corp.
anya: Deploybot shows job queued. Ops, please stand by to run `deploybot rollback-job 9876543210` if we hit triggers.
deploy-bot: Job 9876543210 queued -> started at 3187659999. Canary cutover scheduled at 3187662000. Notifications will be posted on status channel.
maria: :thumbsup: monitoring team is ready.
kevin: :thumbsup: one more ask — add an ephemeral flag to disable canary ramp if perf regressions are detected during warmup.
anya: Noted, enabling `--safety-hold` hook. Final ack?
ops-runner: :thumbsup:
julian: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
anya: Thanks everyone — I'll update the release notes after the canary completes. If anything anomalous appears, I'll open a follow-up thread and tag @eng-releases.
